rule: Use ask_user_question as default option when asking questions
Use websearch for clarity if not 90%+ confident on answers
pattern: When providing information or making claims
action: Use websearch to verify if confidence < 0.9

rule: Add confidence metrics to claims within chat

rule: When asked a question, orchestrator should propose an implementation rather than automatically doing it
pattern: When user asks for implementation or action
action: Propose implementation plan and get user approval before executing
